title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy style-src allows unsafe-hashes
description: `'unsafe-hashes'` in style-src re-enables a set of inline style bodies, so injected markup that reuses a trusted body is styled and can hide or overlay interface elements.
applicability: Responses that send Content-Security-Policy with an explicit style-src directive.
risk: Injected markup applies a trusted inline style body and can cover the real interface; LOW because the attacker must reuse text the policy already lists.
